subject: Apply a pastel dreamlike LUT. See .rundeer/luts/pastel_dream.md for the full LUT specification. Lift blacks substantially, reduce overall contrast, push all colors toward soft muted pastels with lavender shadows, rose-pink midtones, and milky cream highlights. Desaturate deep saturated colors, add a faint blue-purple halation around edges, give the image a dreamy, ethereal, soft-focus feel as if shot through a diffusion filter on Ektachrome pushed one stop. Preserve all composition and subject identity.
